factors.slim: Optional sixth matched mechanism control: Frame40B/Slot56B, same pointer Shared and ready helpers as tail; Cohort.advance merges ready work and completion commit. First deferred Job pointer selects cold; cold Cohort.advance skips earlier survivors and completes deferred/rest in original ascending order. Same-array pointer ordering is valid within the admitted contiguous Cohort span. No scheduler/API change, no presumed static/native speed win; red-zone/cold frame costs separately retained.

physical_work: N16 unchanged Map storage, original/manual consumers and initialized primary/candidate windows; cold-positive lengths proven once; setup/jobs/probes/groups/enqueue/drain included in every timed operation.
visit_semantics: One charged native group visit including ready prefix and bounded cold work; same Cursor forwarded to cold; first downstream prefix not rescanned; remaining active group completed in ascending order; <=effective_grain useful stage work per native visit; one final scheduler yield/finish.
snapshot_contract: Context initialized before configure and every admission, facts/map/hints immutable for the full pending operation. Frame snapshot equals the Shared values initially configured. No set_shared while pending; Context and Frame outlive drain or returned-boundary release/cancellation. Cold helper returns that same pointer, packs bit-identical Shared values, then tails. No per-visit hardware query, atomic, or additional dependency work. Snapshot cold helper ordinary-call cost is charged.
qualification: Native loom_validate16 + O3 ASan/UBSan always-UAR six Loom checks before timing. All ten new caller target forced cases run release and sanitizer. Independently inserted key->next-key oracle, primary hit/miss/downstream hit/miss/real secondary and overflow, ragged zero lengths, exact budgets, queued promotion and active/queued cancellation. Full normal workload also independently checks every result and actual scheduler visits; useful visits derived analytically only for equal chain lengths.
codegen_limit: Source/cross receipts are not native timing. Native runner records per body ordinary calls, emitted instructions, explicit SP instructions and x86 red-zone operations. Entry allocation excludes x86 red zone; RBP is counted as stack only if it is actually established as frame base. Snapshot total cold footprint includes separate ordinary finish_cold helper; wrapper alone is not total footprint.
order_control: Every matched ISA/n/chains cell has two disjoint outer passes: forward0 and reverse1, each seven reps/executable and unchanged eight-arm internal order. Both pass receipts admitted separately and compared for order sensitivity; filenames include pass.
